The central man has long dark hair and wears a white T-shirt. The man to his left is in a beige shirt, and the one to his right wears a dark shirt and a tan cap. They are seated around a wooden coffee table with soup dumplings. (3) The central man picks up a dumpling with chopsticks and eats it. He immediately displays an exaggerated reaction of joy, closing his eyes and shivering, while pink heart icons float around him. (4) A close-up shows the syringe injecting a clear liquid into another soup dumpling sitting in a yellow tray. The three men then taste the food, engaging in an animated discussion with active hand gestures. (5) Another alcohol variety is introduced; a close-up shows the syringe injecting a different clear liquid. The men continue their conversation, looking at each other and laughing. (6) The final test involves a dark liquid. The syringe is shown filling a dumpling. The man on the left eats it, and his facial expression shifts from curiosity to intense disgust. He covers his mouth, stands up, and quickly walks away from the camera, appearing to gag.
